# BenedictBwikizo.github.io
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Malone's Interior | Interior design studio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Malone's Interior designs homes, offices and restaurants around deep colour, warm light and honest materials. Book a free consultation.">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Young+Serif&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#100E0C;
  --bg-2:#161311;
  --panel:#1C1815;
  --panel-2:#241F1B;
  --line:rgba(236,229,216,.13);
  --line-strong:rgba(236,229,216,.26);
  --text:#ECE5D8;
  --muted:#A99F8F;
  --brass:#C9A66B;
  --brass-hi:#DCBF88;
  --brass-ink:#1A140B;
  --danger:#F0977F;
  --serif:'Young Serif','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,serif;
  --sans:'Instrument Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
  --nav-h:68px;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--bg);scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + var(--nav-h) + 12px);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 1.0625rem/1.65 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
[hidden]{display:none !important}
img,svg{max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;margin:0;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.01em}
p{margin:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,100% - 2.5rem);margin-inline:auto}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;padding:.85rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font:600 .97rem/1 var(--sans);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s}
.btn-primary{background:var(--brass);color:var(--brass-ink)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--brass-hi)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line-strong);color:var(--text);background:transparent}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--brass);color:var(--brass-hi)}
.btn-sm{padding:.65rem 1.1rem;font-size:.9rem}

/* Nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:50;background:rgba(16,14,12,.86);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav-in{height:var(--nav-h);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.5rem}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;text-decoration:none;font:400 1.3rem/1 var(--serif);color:var(--text)}
.brand svg{color:var(--brass);flex:none}
.nav nav{display:flex;gap:2rem}
.nav nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;transition:color .2s}
.nav nav a:hover{color:var(--text)}

/* Hero */
.hero{padding:clamp(2.5rem,6vw,5rem) 0 clamp(3.5rem,8vw,7rem)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(2rem,6vw,6rem);align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.7rem,6vw,5.1rem);max-width:12ch}
.hero .lede{margin-top:1.5rem;max-width:34rem;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--muted)}
.hero-cta{margin-top:2.25rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.9rem}
.facts{list-style:none;margin:2.5rem 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem 1.75rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.facts li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}
.facts svg{color:var(--brass);flex:none}

.stage{width:100%;max-width:500px;margin-inline:auto}
.room{position:relative;isolation:isolate;aspect-ratio:828/1035;overflow:hidden;background:#0c0a09;
  border-radius:24% 24% 14px 14px / 9% 9% 14px 14px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);box-shadow:0 40px 90px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.photos{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;isolation:isolate;filter:brightness(.3) saturate(.62) contrast(1.06);transition:filter 1.6s ease}
.photos img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;opacity:0;z-index:0;transition:opacity .9s ease}
.photos img.prev{opacity:1;z-index:1;transition:none}
.photos img.on{opacity:1;z-index:2;transition:opacity .9s ease}
.lit{position:absolute;z-index:1;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;mix-blend-mode:plus-lighter;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease}
.leds{position:absolute;z-index:2;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease}
.room[data-lamp="on"] .photos{filter:none}
.room[data-led="on"] .lit{opacity:1}
.room[data-led="on"] .leds{opacity:.4}
.room[data-led="on"][data-lamp="off"] .leds{opacity:.85}

.room-ui{margin-top:1.25rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem;align-items:flex-start}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;padding:.55rem .95rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:500 .88rem/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--brass)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:var(--brass);background:rgba(201,166,107,.12)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem}
.dots{display:inline-flex}
.dots i{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);margin-left:-3px}
.dots i:first-child{margin-left:0}
.lamp-btn{border-color:var(--brass);color:var(--brass-hi)}
.switches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem}
.sw{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:.5rem .95rem .5rem .6rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:500 .9rem/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.sw:hover{border-color:var(--brass)}
.sw .track{position:relative;flex:none;width:34px;height:20px;border-radius:999px;background:#3a332c;transition:background .25s}
.sw .track::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.sw .state{min-width:1.9em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.sw[aria-checked="true"]{border-color:var(--brass);background:rgba(201,166,107,.1)}
.sw[aria-checked="true"] .track{background:rgba(201,166,107,.4)}
.sw[aria-checked="true"] .track::after{transform:translateX(14px);background:var(--brass-hi)}
.caption{margin-top:1rem;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted);min-height:3.2em}
.caption strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.hint{margin-top:.25rem;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* Sections */
.section{padding:clamp(4rem,9vw,7.5rem) 0}
.section.alt{background:var(--bg-2);border-block:1px solid var(--line)}
.sec-head{max-width:40rem}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.2vw,3.3rem)}
.sec-head p{margin-top:1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.1rem}

/* Services */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.78fr 1.22fr;gap:clamp(2rem,6vw,6rem);align-items:start}
.svc-side{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + var(--nav-h) + 1.5rem)}
.svc-side .for{margin-top:1.5rem;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--muted)}
.mini{margin-top:2rem;padding:1.25rem 1.4rem;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:14px;background:var(--panel)}
.mini strong{display:block;font:400 1.25rem/1.2 var(--serif)}
.mini span{display:block;margin-top:.35rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.mini .btn{margin-top:1.1rem;width:100%}
.svc-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:1rem 2.5rem;align-items:center;padding:1.6rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.svc.is-on{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(201,166,107,.1),transparent 80%);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--brass)}
.svc h3{font-size:1.45rem}
.svc-info p{margin-top:.45rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem;max-width:34rem}
.svc-act{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:.75rem}
.price{font:400 1.35rem/1 var(--serif);white-space:nowrap}
.price span{font:400 .85rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);margin-right:.35rem}
.price small{font:400 .85rem var(--sans);color:var(--muted);margin-left:.3rem}
.add{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.6rem 1.05rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:600 .88rem/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.add:hover{border-color:var(--brass)}
.add svg{display:none}
.add[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--brass);border-color:var(--brass);color:var(--brass-ink)}
.add[aria-pressed="true"] svg{display:block}

/* Palettes */
.pal-grid{margin-top:3.5rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,4rem);max-width:920px}
.pal{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.arch{position:relative;aspect-ratio:828/1035;border-radius:24% 24% 14px 14px / 9% 9% 14px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background-color:#0c0a09;background-size:cover;background-position:center;overflow:hidden;transition:outline-color .25s}
.pal[data-active="true"] .arch{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:5px}
.pal .dotrow{margin-top:1.1rem;display:flex;gap:1.1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
.pal .dotrow span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45rem}
.pal .dotrow i{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.pal h3{margin-top:1rem;font-size:1.6rem}
.pal p{margin-top:.6rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem}
.pal ul{margin:1rem 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pal li{padding:.55rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.95rem}
.pal .btn{margin-top:1.4rem;align-self:flex-start}

/* Process */
.steps{list-style:none;margin:3.5rem 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2rem;counter-reset:s}
.steps li{position:relative;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.steps li::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-6px;left:0;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brass)}
.steps .n{font:400 2.6rem/1 var(--serif);color:var(--brass)}
.steps h3{margin-top:1rem;font-size:1.35rem}
.steps p{margin-top:.6rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem}

/* Commitments */
.commit{margin-top:3.5rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2.5rem}
.commit div{padding-left:1.4rem;border-left:2px solid var(--brass)}
.commit h3{font-size:1.4rem}
.commit p{margin-top:.6rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem}

/* FAQ */
.faq{margin-top:3rem;max-width:52rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;padding:1.3rem 0;font:400 1.2rem/1.3 var(--serif)}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq summary::after{content:"+";font:400 1.6rem/1 var(--sans);color:var(--brass);flex:none}
.faq details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.faq details p{padding:0 3rem 1.4rem 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:44rem}

/* Request */
.req-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:clamp(2rem,6vw,6rem);align-items:start}
.sum{margin-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sum ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.sum li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.75rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.97rem}
.sum li span:last-child{color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.sum li .empty{white-space:normal !important}
.sum .empty{display:block;padding:.9rem 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem}
.sum .empty a{color:var(--brass-hi)}
.sum-total{margin-top:1.1rem;font:400 1.5rem/1.2 var(--serif)}
.sum-note{margin-top:.5rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.panel{padding:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.4rem);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:18px;background:var(--panel)}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.2rem 1.2rem}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.4rem;min-width:0}
.field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.field label,.field .lbl{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--text)}
.field .opt{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;padding:.8rem .9rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 1rem/1.4 var(--sans);transition:border-color .2s}
.field textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:#6F675B}
.field input:focus-visible,.field select:focus-visible,.field textarea:focus-visible{border-color:var(--brass);outline-offset:1px}
.field [aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--danger)}
.err{min-height:0;color:var(--danger);font-size:.86rem}
.stepper{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg);width:max-content}
.stepper button{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:400 1.4rem/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px}
.stepper button:hover{color:var(--brass-hi)}
.stepper output{min-width:2.5rem;text-align:center;font-weight:600}
fieldset.field{border:0;margin:0;padding:0}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem}
.pill{position:relative}
.pill input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer}
.pill span{display:inline-block;padding:.6rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:999px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.pill input:checked+span{border-color:var(--brass);background:rgba(201,166,107,.14)}
.pill input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:3px}
.form-actions{margin-top:1.6rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:center}
.form-actions p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:26rem}
.done h3{font-size:1.9rem}
.done .lead{margin-top:.7rem;color:var(--muted)}
.done textarea{margin-top:1.3rem;width:100%;min-height:270px;padding:1rem;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 .92rem/1.55 var(--sans);resize:vertical}
.send{margin-top:1.3rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem}

/* Footer */
.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:4rem 0 3rem}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;gap:2.5rem}
.foot h3{font-size:1.15rem}
.foot p,.foot a{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem}
.foot ul{list-style:none;margin:.9rem 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.5rem}
.foot a{text-decoration:none}
.foot a:hover{color:var(--brass-hi)}
.foot .fine{margin-top:3rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.85rem}

.hero-grid>*,.svc-grid>*,.req-grid>*,.fgrid>*{min-width:0}

/* Mobile request bar */
.bar{display:none;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:60;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;
  padding:.8rem 1.25rem calc(.8rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:rgba(28,24,21,.96);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .3s ease,visibility 0s .3s}
.bar.show{visibility:visible;transform:none;transition:transform .3s ease}
.bar strong{display:block;font-size:.95rem}
.bar span{display:block;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(1.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:var(--brass);color:var(--brass-ink);padding:.7rem 1.2rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;z-index:80}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .hero-grid,.svc-grid,.req-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero h1{max-width:14ch}
  .svc-side{position:static}
  .svc-side .mini{display:none}
  .bar{display:flex}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .commit{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .foot-grid>div:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}
  .foot{padding-bottom:6rem}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .nav nav{display:none}
  .pal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3rem}
  .pal .arch{max-width:360px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .svc{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1rem}
  .svc-act{flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%}
  .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .faq details p{padding-right:0}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{transition-duration:.01ms !important;animation-duration:.01ms !important}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="nav" id="top">
  <div class="wrap nav-in">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="Malone's Interior, back to top">
      <svg width="22" height="26" viewBox="0 0 22 26" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 25V11a9 9 0 0 1 18 0v14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="11" cy="14" r="2.2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
      <span>Malone's Interior</span>
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Main">
      <a href="#services">Services</a>
      <a href="#palettes">Palettes</a>
      <a href="#process">Process</a>
      <a href="#faq">Questions</a>
    </nav>
    <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="#request">Start a project</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap hero-grid">
      <div>
        <h1>Rooms that glow after dark.</h1>
        <p class="lede">Malone's Interior designs homes, offices and restaurants around deep colour, warm light and honest materials, from the first sketch to the last cushion.</p>
        <div class="hero-cta">
          <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#request">Book a free consultation</a>
          <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#services">Browse services</a>
        </div>
        <ul class="facts">
          <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5l3.2 3L13 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>Free first consultation</li>
          <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5l3.2 3L13 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>Fixed-price quotes</li>
          <li><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5l3.2 3L13 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>Reply within 48 hours</li>
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div class="stage">
        <div class="room" id="room" data-lamp="off">
          <div class="photos" id="photos" role="img" aria-label="Modern kitchen with matte joinery, fluted timber panels, a marble splashback and warm LED lighting under the cabinets and along the plinth"></div>
          <img class="lit" id="litImg" width="828" height="1035" alt="" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg class="leds" viewBox="0 0 828 1035" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" aria-hidden="true">
            <defs>
              <filter id="bloom" filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="828" height="1035"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="26"/></filter>
              <filter id="soft" filterUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="828" height="1035"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/></filter>
            </defs>
            <g fill="none" stroke="#FFC585" stroke-linecap="round">
              <g filter="url(#bloom)" stroke-width="54" opacity=".42">
                <line x1="600" y1="410" x2="800" y2="410"/>
                <line x1="262" y1="426" x2="364" y2="426"/>
                <line x1="170" y1="852" x2="750" y2="1028"/>
              </g>
              <g filter="url(#bloom)" stroke-width="26" opacity=".7">
                <line x1="590" y1="382" x2="806" y2="382"/>
                <line x1="256" y1="398" x2="368" y2="398"/>
                <line x1="160" y1="834" x2="752" y2="1012"/>
              </g>
              <g filter="url(#soft)" stroke-width="5" opacity=".9">
                <line x1="592" y1="381" x2="804" y2="381"/>
                <line x1="258" y1="397" x2="366" y2="397"/>
                <line x1="162" y1="833" x2="752" y2="1011"/>
              </g>
              <g filter="url(#soft)" stroke-width="4" opacity=".45">
                <line x1="365" y1="363" x2="500" y2="363"/>
              </g>
            </g>
          </svg>
        </div>

        <div class="room-ui">
          <div class="chips" id="roomChips" role="group" aria-label="Kitchen palette"></div>
          <div class="switches" role="group" aria-label="Kitchen lighting">
            <button class="sw" id="swRoom" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false"><span class="track" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>Room lights</span><span class="state" aria-hidden="true">Off</span></button>
            <button class="sw" id="swLed" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false"><span class="track" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>LED strips</span><span class="state" aria-hidden="true">Off</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="caption" id="roomCap"><strong>Warm light, honest materials.</strong> Matte grey joinery, fluted timber and LED strips under the cabinets and along the plinth.</p>
        <p class="hint">Switch the room lights and the LED strips on and off separately.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SERVICES -->
  <section class="section alt" id="services">
    <div class="wrap svc-grid">
      <div class="svc-side">
        <div class="sec-head">
          <h2>Services you can order today</h2>
          <p>Add what you need and we'll build your quote around it. Prices are starting points; you get a fixed price in writing before anything is ordered.</p>
        </div>
        <p class="for">We design homes, apartments, offices, restaurants, cafés and shops.</p>
        <div class="mini">
          <strong id="sideCount">No services chosen yet</strong>
          <span id="sideEst">Pick a service to see a starting estimate</span>
          <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#request">Continue to request</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul class="svc-list" id="svcList"></ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- PALETTES -->
  <section class="section" id="palettes">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <h2>Two dark palettes to start from</h2>
        <p>Every project begins with colour. Choose one below and the kitchen at the top of the page is recoloured to match. It's also added to your request. If none feels right, we'll suggest one after your consultation.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pal-grid" id="palGrid"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- PROCESS -->
  <section class="section alt" id="process">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head">
        <h2>How a project runs</h2>
        <p>Four steps, one designer, and no surprises on price.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="steps">
        <li><div class="n">1</div><h3>Free consultation</h3><p>A 30-minute call or visit. We ask how you live, what you want to keep and what you can't stand.</p></li>
        <li><div class="n">2</div><h3>Concept board</h3><p>Within a week you see palette, materials, layout and mood images for your space.</p></li>
        <li><div class="n">3</div><h3>Quote and refine</h3><p>We send a fixed quote and rework the design until it feels right. Two revision rounds are included.</p></li>
        <li><div class="n">4</div><h3>Build and style</h3><p>We order, coordinate the trades, oversee the install and style the room on the final day.</p></li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- COMMITMENTS -->
  <section class="section">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head"><h2>What you can count on</h2></div>
      <div class="commit">
        <div><h3>Prices in writing</h3><p>You get a fixed quote before we order anything. If the scope changes, we tell you first.</p></div>
        <div><h3>One designer, start to finish</h3><p>The person on your first call is the person who styles your room on the last day.</p></div>
        <div><h3>Designed for evenings</h3><p>We plan light, colour and texture for how a room feels after sunset, when most people are actually home.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- FAQ -->
  <section class="section alt" id="faq">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sec-head"><h2>Questions we hear often</h2></div>
      <div class="faq">
        <details><summary>How much does a project cost?</summary><p>Every service lists a starting price. After your consultation we send a fixed quote in writing, and we don't order anything until you approve it.</p></details>
        <details><summary>Can I start with just a consultation?</summary><p>Yes. Book a consultation on its own and decide what to do next afterwards. There's no obligation to continue.</p></details>
        <details><summary>Can you work with my builder or contractor?</summary><p>Yes. We can work with your team or bring in trusted trades. Either way we give them clear drawings and stay available during the install.</p></details>
        <details><summary>Do you work remotely?</summary><p>Yes. Concept boards, 3D views and sourcing all work over video and WhatsApp. Site visits are best for measuring and for install day.</p></details>
        <details><summary>What if I don't like the concept?</summary><p>Each design service includes two revision rounds. Tell us what's off and we rework the board until it feels right.</p></details>
        <details><summary>How long does a room take?</summary><p>Design usually takes two to three weeks. Delivery and install depend on furniture lead times, and we put dates in your quote.</p></details>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- REQUEST -->
  <section class="section" id="request">
    <div class="wrap req-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="sec-head">
          <h2>Tell us about your space</h2>
          <p>Send a project request in a couple of minutes. We reply within 48 hours with next steps and a time for your free consultation.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="sum" aria-live="polite">
          <ul id="sumList"></ul>
          <p class="sum-total" id="sumTotal"></p>
          <p class="sum-note" id="sumNote"></p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel">
        <form id="reqForm" novalidate>
          <div class="fgrid">
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fName">Your name</label>
              <input id="fName" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" aria-describedby="eName">
              <span class="err" id="eName"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fPhone">WhatsApp or phone</label>
              <input id="fPhone" name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel" placeholder="+255 ..." aria-describedby="ePhone">
              <span class="err" id="ePhone"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="field full">
              <label for="fEmail">Email <span class="opt">(optional)</span></label>
              <input id="fEmail" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" aria-describedby="eEmail">
              <span class="err" id="eEmail"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fType">Type of space</label>
              <select id="fType" name="type" aria-describedby="eType">
                <option value="">Choose one</option>
                <option>House</option>
                <option>Apartment</option>
                <option>Office</option>
                <option>Restaurant or café</option>
                <option>Shop or boutique</option>
                <option>Other</option>
              </select>
              <span class="err" id="eType"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <span class="lbl" id="roomsLbl">How many rooms?</span>
              <div class="stepper" role="group" aria-labelledby="roomsLbl">
                <button type="button" id="roomsMinus" aria-label="Fewer rooms">&minus;</button>
                <output id="roomsOut" aria-live="polite">1</output>
                <button type="button" id="roomsPlus" aria-label="More rooms">+</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <fieldset class="field full">
              <legend class="lbl" style="padding:0;margin-bottom:.4rem">Palette</legend>
              <div class="pills" id="palPills"></div>
            </fieldset>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="f">Budget</label>
              <select id="fBudget" name="budget"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="field">
              <label for="fWhen">When do you want to start?</label>
              <select id="fWhen" name="when">
                <option>As soon as possible</option>
                <option>Within 1 to 3 months</option>
                <option>Later this year</option>
                <option>Just exploring</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div class="field full">
              <label for="fNotes">Notes <span class="opt">(optional if you chose services)</span></label>
              <textarea id="fNotes" name="notes" placeholder="Tell us about the space, what you want to keep, and anything you dislike." aria-describedby="eNotes"></textarea>
              <span class="err" id="eNotes"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-actions">
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Review my request</button>
            <p>You'll see your full request first. It's only sent when you choose WhatsApp or email.</p>
          </div>
        </form>

        <div class="done" id="done" hidden>
          <h3>Your request is ready</h3>
          <p class="lead">Send it to Malone's Interior with WhatsApp or email. Nothing is sent until you choose one.</p>
          <textarea id="doneText" readonly aria-label="Your request text"></textarea>
          <div class="send">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" id="sendWa" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Send on WhatsApp</a>
            <a class="btn btn-ghost" id="sendMail" href="#">Send by email</a>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="copyBtn" type="button">Copy request</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="editBtn" type="button">Edit request</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer class="foot">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="foot-grid">
      <div>
        <a class="brand" href="#top"><svg width="22" height="26" viewBox="0 0 22 26" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 25V11a9 9 0 0 1 18 0v14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="11" cy="14" r="2.2" fill="currentColor"/></svg><span>Malone's Interior</span></a>
        <p style="margin-top:1rem;max-width:26rem">An interior design studio for homes and businesses that want deep colour, warm light and rooms that feel finished.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3>Get in touch</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><a id="footWa" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a></li>
          <li><a id="footMail" href="#">Email the studio</a></li>
          <li><a href="#request">Send a project request</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
        <h3>Studio hours</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><p>Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm</p></li>
          <li><p>Site visits by appointment</p></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="fine">&copy; 2026 Malone's Interior. All rights reserved.</p>
  </div>
</footer>

<div class="bar" id="bar" role="region" aria-label="Your request so far">
  <div><strong id="barCount"></strong><span id="barEst"></span></div>
  <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="#request">Continue</a>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
/* ========= Edit these to make the site yours ========= */
const CFG = {
  currency: "TZS",                  // currency code for your country
  country: "Tanzania",              // country name for your quote text
  whatsapp: "255700000000",          // WhatsApp number, digits only, with country code
  email: "hello@malonesinterior.com"  // where email requests go
};

const PALETTES = {
  charcoal: {
    name: "Charcoal & Brass",
    blurb: "Graphite joinery and walls, smoked oak and brushed brass. Calm and grown-up for kitchens, bedrooms and offices.",
    materials: ["Limewash plaster", "Smoked oak", "Bouclé and brushed brass"],
    note: "Smoked oak with graphite joinery.",
    wood: "#706357", cab: "#4E4B49", brass: "#D2B47C"
  },
  blackgrey: {
    name: "Black & Gray",
    blurb: "Matte black joinery against pale grey-washed oak and steel. Sharp, modern and quiet, for kitchens, offices and shops.",
    materials: ["Matte black lacquer", "Grey-washed oak", "Brushed steel and concrete"],
    note: "Grey-washed oak with matte black joinery.",
    wood: "#767472", cab: "#3A3A3B", brass: "#A9ADB2"
  }
};
const DEFAULT_NOTE = "Matte grey joinery, fluted timber and LED strips under the cabinets and along the plinth.";

/* Photos are embedded so the page stays a single file: LED-off base, one recoloured version per palette, and the LED light layer. */
const IMG = {
  base: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  charcoal: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  blackgrey: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  lit: "data:image/webp;base64,"
};

const SERVICES = [
  { id:"consult",  name:"Design consultation",              unit:"flat", label:"per sq", blurb:"Two hours with a designer, at your space or on video. You leave with a clear direction, a palette and a to-do list." },
  { id:"room",     name:"Room makeover design",             unit:"room", label:"per room",    blurb:"Layout, palette, materials and a shopping list for one room, presented on a concept board." },
  { id:"home",     name:"Whole-home design",                unit:"flat", label:"per home",    blurb:"One cohesive scheme for every room, with a complete furniture and lighting plan." },
  { id:"lighting", name:"Lighting plan",                    unit:"room", label:"per room",    blurb:"Layers of ambient, task and accent light, with fixture choices and exact positions." },
  { id:"visual",   name:"3D visualisation",                 unit:"room", label:"per room",    blurb:"See your finished room from several angles before you buy or build anything." },
  { id:"sourcing", name:"Sourcing and styling",             unit:"flat", label:"per project", blurb:"We find, order and track furniture, rugs and art, then style the room on install day. Items are charged at cost." },
  { id:"commercial", name:"Café, office and shop interiors", unit:"flat", label:"per space", blurb:"Concept, layout and finishes for commercial spaces, built around how customers and staff move through them." }
];

const BUDGETS = ["Under 1,000","1,000 to 3,000","3,000 to 8,000","8,000 and above","Not sure yet"];

/* ========= State ========= */
const $ = (s, r=document) => r.querySelector(s);
const state = { palette:null, lamp:false, led:false, touched:false, selected:new Set(), rooms:1 };
const money = n => CFG.currency + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

function estimate(){
  let t = 0;
  SERVICES.forEach(s => { if(state.selected.has(s.id)) t += s.unit === "room" ? s.price * state.rooms : s.price; });
  return t;
}

/* ========= Room ========= */
const room = $("#room"), swRoom = $("#swRoom"), swLed = $("#swLed");

function syncSwitch(btn, on){
  btn.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(on));
  btn.querySelector(".state").textContent = on ? "On" : "Off";
}
function setLamp(on){ state.lamp = on; room.dataset.lamp = on ? "on" : "off"; syncSwitch(swRoom, on); }
function setLed(on){ state.led = on; room.dataset.led = on ? "on" : "off"; syncSwitch(swLed, on); }
swRoom.addEventListener("click", () => { state.touched = true; setLamp(!state.lamp); });
swLed.addEventListener("click", () => { state.touched = true; setLed(!state.led); });

/* kitchen photos: stacked, cross-faded when the palette changes */
const photos = $("#photos"), variants = {};
["base","charcoal","blackgrey"].forEach(k => {
  const im = new Image(); im.src = IMG[k]; im.alt = ""; im.width = 828; im.height = 1035; im.decoding = "async";
  photos.appendChild(im); variants[k] = im;
});
variants.base.classList.add("on");
$("#litImg").src = IMG.lit;
let currentVariant = "base";
function showVariant(name){
  if(name === currentVariant) return;
  const prev = variants[currentVariant], next = variants[name];
  prev.classList.remove("on"); prev.classList.add("prev");
  next.classList.remove("prev"); next.classList.add("on");
  currentVariant = name;
  setTimeout(() => { if(prev !== variants[currentVariant]) prev.classList.remove("prev"); }, 1000);
}

function paintRoom(key){
  showVariant(key || "base");
  document.querySelectorAll("#roomChips .chip").forEach(c => c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(c.dataset.pal === (key || "none"))));
  document.querySelectorAll(".pal").forEach(c => c.dataset.active = String(c.dataset.pal === key));
  document.querySelectorAll(".pal .btn").forEach(b => { b.textContent = b.closest(".pal").dataset.pal === key ? "Selected palette" : "Use this palette"; });
  $("#roomCap").innerHTML = key
    ? "<strong>" + PALETTES[key].name + ".</strong> " + PALETTES[key].note + " Lighting and layout stay the same."
    : "<strong>Warm light, honest materials.</strong> " + DEFAULT_NOTE;
}
function choosePalette(key){                    /* key: a palette id, or null for the original photo */
  state.palette = key;
  paintRoom(key);
  const r = document.querySelector('#palPills input[value="' + (key || "unsure") + '"]');
  if(r) r.checked = true;
}

/* palette chips above the kitchen */
$("#roomChips").innerHTML = '<button class="chip" type="button" data-pal="none" aria-pressed="true">Original</button>' +
  Object.entries(PALETTES).map(([k,p]) =>
    '<button class="chip" type="button" data-pal="' + k + '" aria-pressed="false"><span class="dots"><i style="background:' + p.wood + '"></i><i style="background:' + p.cab + '"></i><i style="background:' + p.brass + '"></i></span>' + p.name.replace("&","&amp;") + '</button>'
  ).join("");
$("#roomChips").addEventListener("click", e => { const b = e.target.closest(".chip"); if(b) choosePalette(b.dataset.pal === "none" ? null : b.dataset.pal); });

/* palette cards */
$("#palGrid").innerHTML = Object.entries(PALETTES).map(([k,p]) =>
  '<article class="pal" data-pal="' + k + '" data-active="false">' +
    '<div class="arch" role="img" aria-label="The kitchen in ' + p.name.replace("&","and") + '"></div>' +
    '<div class="dotrow"><span><i style="background:' + p.wood + '"></i>Timber</span><span><i style="background:' + p.cab + '"></i>Joinery</span><span><i style="background:' + p.brass + '"></i>Metal</span></div>' +
    '<h3>' + p.name.replace("&","&amp;") + '</h3><p>' + p.blurb + '</p>' +
    '<ul>' + p.materials.map(m => '<li>' + m + '</li>').join("") + '</ul>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-ghost" type="button">Use this palette</button></article>'
).join("");
document.querySelectorAll(".pal").forEach(c => { c.querySelector(".arch").style.backgroundImage = "url(" + IMG[c.dataset.pal] + ")"; });
$("#palGrid").addEventListener("click", e => {
  const b = e.target.closest(".btn"); if(!b) return;
  choosePalette(b.closest(".pal").dataset.pal);
  showToast("Kitchen recoloured and palette added to your request");
});

/* form palette pills */
$("#palPills").innerHTML = Object.entries(PALETTES).map(([k,p]) =>
  '<label class="pill"><input type="radio" name="palette" value="' + k + '"><span>' + p.name.replace("&","&amp;") + '</span></label>'
).join("") + '<label class="pill"><input type="radio" name="palette" value="unsure"><span>Not sure yet</span></label>';
$("#palPills").addEventListener("change", e => choosePalette(e.target.value === "unsure" ? null : e.target.value));

/* budget options */
/* prefix the currency to every number in the budget ranges */
$("#fBudget").innerHTML = BUDGETS.map(b => {
  if(!/\d/.test(b)) return "<option>" + b + "</option>";
  return "<option>" + b.replace(/(\d[\d,]*)/g, CFG.currency + "$1") + "</option>";
}).join("");

/* ========= Services ========= */
const check = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 8.5l3.2 3L13 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
$("#svcList").innerHTML = SERVICES.map(s =>
  '<li class="svc" data-id="' + s.id + '"><div class="svc-info"><h3>' + s.name + '</h3><p>' + s.blurb + '</p></div>' +
  
  '<button class="add" type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-id="' + s.id + '" aria-label="Add ' + s.name + ' to request">' + check + '<span>Add to request</span></button></div></li>'
).join("");

$("#svcList").addEventListener("click", e => {
  const b = e.target.closest(".add"); if(!b) return;
  const id = b.dataset.id, on = !state.selected.has(id);
  on ? state.selected.add(id) : state.selected.delete(id);
  b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
  b.querySelector("span").textContent = on ? "Added" : "Add to request";
  b.closest(".svc").classList.toggle("is-on", on);
  updateSummary();
});

let reqVisible = false;
function updateSummary(){
  const n = state.selected.size, est = estimate();
  const count = n ? n + (n === 1 ? " service chosen" : " services chosen") : "No services chosen yet";
  const estTxt = n ? "Estimate from " + money(est) : "Pick a service to see a starting estimate";
  $("#sideCount").textContent = count; $("#sideEst").textContent = estTxt;
  $("#barCount").textContent = count;  $("#barEst").textContent = estTxt;

  const list = $("#sumList");
  if(!n){
    list.innerHTML = '<li class="empty" style="display:block;border:0"><span class="empty" style="padding:0">No services chosen yet. <a href="#services">Browse services</a> or describe what you need in the notes.</span></li>';
    $("#sumTotal").textContent = ""; $("#sumNote").textContent = "";
  } else {
    list.innerHTML = SERVICES.filter(s => state.selected.has(s.id)).map(s => {
      const line = s.unit === "room" ? s.price * state.rooms : s.price;
      const extra = s.unit === "room" && state.rooms > 1 ? " (" + state.rooms + " rooms)" : "";
      return "<li><span>" + s.name + extra + "</span><span>from " + money(line) + "</span></li>";
    }).join("");
    $("#sumTotal").textContent = "Estimate from " + money(est);
    $("#sumNote").textContent = "This is a starting estimate. We confirm an exact fixed price after your consultation.";
  }
  $("#bar").classList.toggle("show", n > 0 && !reqVisible);
}

new IntersectionObserver(es => { reqVisible = es[0].isIntersecting; $("#bar").classList.toggle("show", state.selected.size > 0 && !reqVisible); }, {threshold:.15}).observe($("#request"));

/* rooms stepper */
function setRooms(n){ state.rooms = Math.min(12, Math.max(1, n)); $("#roomsOut").textContent = state.rooms; updateSummary(); }
$("#roomsMinus").addEventListener("click", () => setRooms(state.rooms - 1));
$("#roomsPlus").addEventListener("click", () => setRooms(state.rooms + 1));

/* ========= Form ========= */
const form = $("#reqForm");
function setErr(id, fieldId, msg){
  $("#" + id).textContent = msg || "";
  const f = $("#" + fieldId);
  if(msg) f.setAttribute("aria-invalid","true"); else f.removeAttribute("aria-invalid");
  return !msg;
}
["fName","fPhone","fEmail","fType","fNotes"].forEach(id => {
  $("#" + id).addEventListener("input", () => { const e = "e" + id.slice(1); $("#" + e).textContent = ""; $("#" + id).removeAttribute("aria-invalid"); });
});

function buildMessage(){
  const v = k => form.elements[k].value.trim();
  const pal = form.elements.palette.value;
  const palName = pal && PALETTES[pal] ? PALETTES[pal].name : "Not sure yet";
  const svc = SERVICES.filter(s => state.selected.has(s.id));
  const lines = [
    "New project request for Malone's Interior",
    "",
    "Name: " + v("name"),
    "WhatsApp or phone: " + v("phone"),
    "Email: " + (v("email") || "Not given"),
    "Type of space: " + v("type"),
    "Rooms: " + state.rooms,
    "Palette: " + palName,
    "Budget: " + v("budget"),
    "Start: " + v("when"),
    "",
    "Services:"
  ];
  if(svc.length){
    svc.forEach(s => lines.push("- " + s.name + " (from " + money(s.price) + " " + s.label + ")"));
    lines.push("Estimate from: " + money(estimate()));
  } else lines.push("- None chosen, see notes");
  lines.push("", "Notes: " + (v("notes") || "None"));
  return lines.join("\n");
}

form.addEventListener("submit", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const v = k => form.elements[k].value.trim();
  const results = [
    setErr("eName","fName", v("name") ? "" : "Enter your name so we know who to reply to."),
    setErr("ePhone","fPhone", v("phone").replace(/\D/g,"").length >= 7 ? "" : "Enter a WhatsApp or phone number with at least 7 digits."),
    setErr("eEmail","fEmail", !v("email") || /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v("email")) ? "" : "Check the email address. It should look like name@example.com."),
    setErr("eType","fType", v("type") ? "" : "Choose the type of space you want designed."),
    setErr("eNotes","fNotes", (state.selected.size || v("notes")) ? "" : "Choose a service above or tell us what you need here.")
  ];
  if(results.includes(false)){
    const first = form.querySelector('[aria-invalid="true"]'); if(first) first.focus();
    return;
  }
  const msg = buildMessage();
  $("#doneText").value = msg;
  $("#sendWa").href = "https://wa.me/" + CFG.whatsapp + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(msg);
  $("#sendMail").href = "mailto:" + CFG.email + "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent("Project request from " + v("name")) + "&body=" + encodeURIComponent(msg);
  form.hidden = true; $("#done").hidden = false;
  $("#done").scrollIntoView({behavior: reduced ? "auto" : "smooth", block:"start"});
});

$("#editBtn").addEventListener("click", () => { $("#done").hidden = true; form.hidden = false; $("#fName").focus(); });

$("#copyBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const ta = $("#doneText");
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(ta.value);
    showToast("Request copied");
  } catch(err){
    ta.focus(); ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand("copy") ? showToast("Request copied") : showToast("Text selected. Press Ctrl+C or long-press to copy."); }
    catch(e2){ showToast("Text selected. Press Ctrl+C or long-press to copy."); }
  }
});

let toastT;
function showToast(t){ const el = $("#toast"); el.textContent = t; el.classList.add("show"); clearTimeout(toastT); toastT = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("show"), 2600); }

/* footer links */
$("#footWa").href = "https://wa.me/" + CFG.whatsapp;
$("#footMail").href = "mailto:" + CFG.email;

/* ========= Init ========= */
document.querySelector('#palPills input[value="unsure"]').checked = true;
paintRoom(null);
updateSummary();
if(reduced){ setLamp(true); setLed(true); }
else {
  setLamp(false); setLed(false);
  setTimeout(() => { if(!state.touched) setLed(true); }, 700);    /* the LED strips glow first */
  setTimeout(() => { if(!state.touched) setLamp(true); }, 2400);  /* then the room lights come up */
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
